notes.title: Farm Manager Word - 1.0 Release today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258445/0881139a8e380c51949a0574e7c8875cfacce918.png[/img]

[h1]What will you find new in Farm Manager Word that wasn't in Farm Manager 2021?[/h1]
[list]
[*] 3 new Campaigns
[*] 8 new scenarios
[*] 3 multiplayer scenarios
[*] Regions of the world (Europe, Central America, Asia)
->  Various climate, terrain, vegetation
->  Changed some buildings look based on region
[*] Fields and work in the fields
-> More metrics for fields: soil class, pH, nitrogen levels.
-> Crop rotation
-> Connecting/disconnecting fields
-> Possibility of automatic mechanical/manual operation or independent
-> selection of vehicles and workers
-> Ability to add workers to ongoing field work
[*] Crops
->  80 crop species (32 new)
->  Plants compedium
[*] Animals
->  Cyclic ordering/selling of animals
->  Young animals
->  20 species of animals (3 new +2)
->  distinguishing between laying and meat hens
->  distinguishing between dairy and meat cows
[*] Vehicles
-> 35 refreshed vehicles and machines (new orchard tractor)
->  Fuel
->  Manufacturing plants
->  New processing plants including biorefinery
->  Many new product types
->  Ability to create more production lines
[*] Multiplayer
->  Exchange of products and machines
->  Collaborative completion of scenario objectives
->  Shared free game
[*] Employees
->  Changed skills system
->  New look
->  Choosing if employee can be a driver
[*] Mods support
[*] Planning mode for creating farm layout
[*] Trading Contracts
[*] More leasing options
[*] Help Center
[*] Logistic system
[*] Resource orders in warehouses
[*] New trainings
[*] Refreshed and expanded interface
[*] Improved graphics and optimization
[/list]

notes.title: Automating work AI patch is live!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Farmers,[/b]

In the past few weeks, there has been one major point of improvement that we’ve been working on: [b]automating work AI[/b]. We want to say [i]“thank you”[/i] once again to our amazing community for taking part in the testing phase of this new feature. We hope that all of you will find it useful.

From this moment, once you reach [b]level 2 of the Farmer Building[/b], you can assign a manager to each field for each crop you have. The field is now being supervised by the [b]AI[/b]. It means it will send both people and machines to work and order necessary products until you harvest the crops.

Besides our main focus point, we managed to implement some smaller fixes. Here is the full list of changes introduced in the newest patch:

[list][*]New feature – automating work AI,
[*]Fixed inability to repair the broken machine,
[*]Fixed the issue with saving scenario goals,
[*]More optimisation changes,
[*]Minor bug fixes.[/list]

[b]Thanks for the support,[/b]
[i]Cleversan Software[/i]

notes.title: We are back on Steam
notes.content:
We have a good news! We are back on the Steam Store.
We have not rested all this time, we are still working on new features and patches. In recent updates, we have improved:

- Left shift for buying all animals at once
- Optimization fixes for windturbines
- Optimization fixed for beehives
-Many optimization improvements
- Fix for goods reservation by slaughterhouse which makes empty stock in animals warehouse
- Added Hungarian translations
- Added Japanese translations
- Fix for prices of used machines (it has to be lower (nonlinear) than buying price)
- Better path for workers during harvesting with chest trailer
- Restored all tractor types for planting trees
- Longer expiry date for meat and cucumber seeds
- Fix for blinking rooftops of pigsty
- Improvements and fixes for stopped production and delivering animals to slaughterhouses
- Changes in autofill
- Disabled production building audio source on game loading
- Improvements in feeding
- Improvements in factories
- Fixes in mowing resources from animals building to warehouse
- Fixes in amount of resources produced by animals
- Allowing for mowing resources from animals building to warehouse when staff is going for food (in same target building)
- Autoinsemination
- Enabled mods
- Numbering fields and buildings of the same kind
- Ukrainian translations
- Korean translations
- Other fixes and modifications

Stay tuned for more:)
